segments.source: **Example 7.5.5. Actuarial Exam Question.** A group dental policy has a negative binomial claim count distribution with mean 300 and variance 800.
segments.translation: **예제 7.5.5. 계리사 시험 문제.** 어떤 단체 치과 보험의 청구 건수는 평균이 300이고 분산이 800인 음이항 분포를 따릅니다.

segments.source: Ground-up severity is given by the following table:
segments.translation: 원손실 심도는 다음 표와 같습니다.

segments.source: You expect severity to increase 50\% with no change in frequency.
segments.translation: 빈도는 변하지 않고 심도는 50% 증가할 것으로 예상합니다.

segments.source: You decide to impose a per claim deductible of 100.
segments.translation: 청구 건당 100의 공제액을 부과하기로 합니다.

segments.source: Calculate the expected total claim payment $S$ after these changes.
segments.translation: 이러한 변경 후 지급되는 총청구액의 기댓값 $S$을 계산하십시오.

segments.source: Show Example Solution
segments.translation: 예제 풀이 보기

segments.source: The cost per loss with a 50\% increase in severity and a 100 deductible per claim is \begin{eqnarray*} X^L &=& \left\{ \begin{array}{cc} 0 & 1.5x<100 \\ 1.5x-100 & 1.5x\ge 100\\ \end{array} \right. \end{eqnarray*} This has expectation $$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}(X^L) &= \frac{1}{4} \left[ \left(1.5(40)-100\right)_+ + \left(1.5(80)-100\right)_+ + \left(1.5(120)-100\right)_+ + \left(1.5(200)-100\right)_+ \right]  \\ &= \frac{1}{4}\left[ (60-100)_+ + (120-100)_+ + (180-100)_+ + (300-100)_+\right] \\ &= \frac{1}{4}\left[ 0 + 20 + 80 + 200 \right] = 75 . \end{aligned}$$ Thus, the expected aggregate loss is
segments.translation: 심도가 50% 증가하고 청구 건당 공제액이 100일 때 손실당 비용은 \begin{eqnarray*} X^L &=& \left\{ \begin{array}{cc} 0 & 1.5x<100 \\ 1.5x-100 & 1.5x\ge 100\\ \end{array} \right. \end{eqnarray*}입니다. 이것의 기댓값은 $$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}(X^L) &= \frac{1}{4} \left[ \left(1.5(40)-100\right)_+ + \left(1.5(80)-100\right)_+ + \left(1.5(120)-100\right)_+ + \left(1.5(200)-100\right)_+ \right]  \\ &= \frac{1}{4}\left[ (60-100)_+ + (120-100)_+ + (180-100)_+ + (300-100)_+\right] \\ &= \frac{1}{4}\left[ 0 + 20 + 80 + 200 \right] = 75 . \end{aligned}$$입니다. 따라서 기대 총손실은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: **Example 7.5.6. Follow-Up.** What is the variance of the total claim payment, $\mathrm{Var~}(S)$?
segments.translation: **예제 7.5.6. 후속 문제.** 지급되는 총청구액 $\mathrm{Var~}(S)$의 분산은 얼마입니까?

segments.source: Show Example Solution
segments.translation: 예제 풀이 보기

segments.source: On a per loss basis, we have $$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(S) &= \mathrm{E}(N) ~ \mathrm{Var}\left(  X^L \right) + \left[ \mathrm{E} \left(X^L\right) \right]^2 ~ \mathrm{Var} (N) \end{aligned}$$ where $\mathrm{E}(N) = 300$ and $\mathrm{Var}(N) = 800$.
segments.translation: 손실당 기준으로 $$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(S) &= \mathrm{E}(N) ~ \mathrm{Var}\left(  X^L \right) + \left[ \mathrm{E} \left(X^L\right) \right]^2 ~ \mathrm{Var} (N) \end{aligned}$$이며, 여기서 $\mathrm{E}(N) = 300$이고 $\mathrm{Var}(N) = 800$입니다.

segments.source: We find $$ \begin{aligned} &\mathrm{E} \left[ (X^L)^2 \right] = \frac{1}{4} \left[ 0^2 + 20^2 + 80^2 + 200^2 \right] = 11,700 \\ \Rightarrow \ & \mathrm{Var}(X^L) = \mathrm{E} \left[ (X^L)^2 \right] - \left[ \mathrm{E}(X^L) \right]^2 = 11,700 - 75^2 = 6,075 \end{aligned} $$ Thus, the variance of the aggregate claim payment is
segments.translation: $$ \begin{aligned} &\mathrm{E} \left[ (X^L)^2 \right] = \frac{1}{4} \left[ 0^2 + 20^2 + 80^2 + 200^2 \right] = 11,700 \\ \Rightarrow \ & \mathrm{Var}(X^L) = \mathrm{E} \left[ (X^L)^2 \right] - \left[ \mathrm{E}(X^L) \right]^2 = 11,700 - 75^2 = 6,075 \end{aligned} $$를 얻습니다. 따라서 총청구액 지급액의 분산은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: *Alternative Method: Using the Per Payment Basis.* Previously, we calculated the expected total claim payment by multiplying the expected number of losses by the expected payment *per loss*.
segments.translation: *대안적 방법: 지급당 기준 사용.* 앞에서는 기대 손실 건수에 *손실당* 기대 지급액을 곱하여 기대 총청구액 지급액을 계산했습니다.

segments.source: Recall that we can also multiply the expected number of payments by the expected payment *per payment*.
segments.translation: 기대 지급 건수에 *지급당* 기대 지급액을 곱해도 된다는 점을 상기하십시오.

segments.source: In this case, we have \[S=X_1^P + \cdots + X_{N_P}^P \] The probability of a payment is \[\Pr(1.5X \ge 100)=\Pr(X \ge 66.\bar{6})=\frac{3}{4} .\] Thus, the number of payments, $N^P$ has a negative binomial distribution (see negative binomial special case in Section \@ref(S:Sec752)) with mean $$\mathrm{E}(N^P) =  \mathrm{E}(N^L)~\Pr(1.5X \geq 100) = 300 \left(\frac{3}{4} \right)=225 .$$ The cost per payment is \begin{eqnarray*} X^P &=& \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \text{undefined}~, & \text{if }~ 1.5x<100 \\ 1.5x-100~, & \text{if } ~ 1.5x\ge 100\\ \end{array} \right. \end{eqnarray*} This has expectation $$ \mathrm{E}(X^P)=\frac{\mathrm{E}(X^L)}{\Pr(1.5X > 100)}=\frac{75}{(3/4)}=100 . $$ Thus, as before, the expected aggregate loss is
segments.translation: 이 경우 \[S=X_1^P + \cdots + X_{N_P}^P \]입니다. 지급이 발생할 확률은 \[\Pr(1.5X \ge 100)=\Pr(X \ge 66.\bar{6})=\frac{3}{4} .\]입니다. 따라서 지급 건수 $N^P$는 평균이 $$\mathrm{E}(N^P) =  \mathrm{E}(N^L)~\Pr(1.5X \geq 100) = 300 \left(\frac{3}{4} \right)=225 .$$인 음이항 분포를 따릅니다(\@ref(S:Sec752)절의 음이항 특수한 경우를 참조하십시오). 지급당 비용은 \begin{eqnarray*} X^P &=& \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} \text{undefined}~, & \text{if }~ 1.5x<100 \\ 1.5x-100~, & \text{if } ~ 1.5x\ge 100\\ \end{array} \right. \end{eqnarray*}입니다. 이것의 기댓값은 $$ \mathrm{E}(X^P)=\frac{\mathrm{E}(X^L)}{\Pr(1.5X > 100)}=\frac{75}{(3/4)}=100 . $$입니다. 따라서 앞에서와 같이 기대 총손실은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: **Example 7.5.7. Actuarial Exam Question.** A company insures a fleet of vehicles.
segments.translation: **예제 7.5.7. 계리사 시험 문제.** 어떤 회사가 차량 군을 보험에 가입시킵니다.

segments.source: Aggregate losses have a compound Poisson distribution.
segments.translation: 총손실은 복합 포아송 분포를 따릅니다.

segments.source: The expected number of losses is 20.
segments.translation: 기대 손실 건수는 20입니다.

segments.source: Loss amounts, regardless of vehicle type, have exponential distribution with $\theta=200$.
segments.translation: 손실 금액은 차량 종류와 관계없이 $\theta=200$인 지수분포를 따릅니다.

segments.source: To reduce the cost of the insurance, two modifications are to be made:
segments.translation: 보험 비용을 줄이기 위해 다음 두 가지 변경을 하려고 합니다.

segments.source: (i) A certain type of vehicle will not be insured.
segments.translation: (i) 특정 종류의 차량은 보험에 가입시키지 않습니다.

segments.source: It is estimated that this will reduce loss frequency by 20$\%$.
segments.translation: 이로 인해 손실 빈도가 20$\%$ 감소할 것으로 추정됩니다.

segments.source: (ii) A deductible of 100 per loss will be imposed.
segments.translation: (ii) 손실당 100의 공제액을 부과합니다.

segments.source: Calculate the expected aggregate amount paid by the insurer after the modifications.
segments.translation: 변경 이후 보험자가 지급하는 기대 총지급액을 계산하십시오.

segments.source: Show Example Solution
segments.translation: 예제 풀이 보기

segments.source: On a per loss basis, we have a 100 deductible.
segments.translation: 손실당 기준으로 공제액은 100입니다.

segments.source: Thus, the expectation per loss is $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}( X^L) &= E[(X-100)_+] = E(X) - E(X\wedge 100) \\ &= 200 - 200(1-e^{-100/200}) = 121.31 . \end{aligned} $$ Loss frequency has been reduced by 20$\%$, resulting in an expected number of losses $$ \mathrm{E}(N^L) = 0.8(20) = 16 . $$ Thus, the expected aggregate amount paid after the modifications is
segments.translation: 따라서 손실당 기댓값은 $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}( X^L) &= E[(X-100)_+] = E(X) - E(X\wedge 100) \\ &= 200 - 200(1-e^{-100/200}) = 121.31 . \end{aligned} $$입니다. 손실 빈도가 20$\%$ 감소하였으므로 기대 손실 건수는 $$ \mathrm{E}(N^L) = 0.8(20) = 16 . $$입니다. 따라서 변경 이후의 기대 총지급액은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: *Alternative Method: Using the Per Payment Basis.* We can also use the per payment basis to find the expected aggregate amount paid after the modifications.
segments.translation: *대안적 방법: 지급당 기준 사용.* 지급당 기준을 사용하여 변경 이후의 기대 총지급액을 구할 수도 있습니다.

segments.source: With the deductible of 100, the probability that a payment occurs is $\Pr(X > 100) = e^{-100/200}$.
segments.translation: 공제액이 100일 때 지급이 발생할 확률은 $\Pr(X > 100) = e^{-100/200}$입니다.

segments.source: For the per payment severity, plugging in the expression for $\mathrm{E}(X^L)$ from the original example, we have $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E} (X^P) = \frac{\mathrm{E} (X^L)}{\Pr(X > 100)} = \frac{200 - 200(1-e^{-100/200})}{e^{-100/200}} = 200 \end{aligned} $$ This is not surprising -- recall that the exponential distribution is `r Gloss('memoryless')`, so the expected claim amount paid in excess of 100 is still exponential with mean 200.
segments.translation: 지급당 심도에 대해서는 원래 예제의 $\mathrm{E}(X^L)$에 대한 식을 대입하면 $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E} (X^P) = \frac{\mathrm{E} (X^L)}{\Pr(X > 100)} = \frac{200 - 200(1-e^{-100/200})}{e^{-100/200}} = 200 \end{aligned} $$를 얻습니다. 이는 놀라운 일이 아닙니다. 지수분포는 `r Gloss('memoryless')`이므로, 100을 초과하여 지급되는 기대 청구액은 여전히 평균이 200인 지수분포를 따른다는 점을 상기하십시오.

segments.source: Now we look at the payment frequency $$ \mathrm{E} (N^P) = \mathrm{E}(N^L)~\Pr(X>100) = 16 ~e^{-100/200} = 9.7. $$ Putting this together, we produce the same answer using the per payment basis as the per loss basis from earlier
segments.translation: 이제 지급 빈도 $$ \mathrm{E} (N^P) = \mathrm{E}(N^L)~\Pr(X>100) = 16 ~e^{-100/200} = 9.7. $$를 살펴봅니다. 이를 종합하면 지급당 기준을 사용해도 앞에서 손실당 기준으로 구한 것과 같은 답을 얻습니다.

segments.source: Individual Risk Model Properties
segments.translation: 개별위험모형의 성질

segments.source: For the expected value of the aggregate loss under the individual risk model, $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}(S_n) &=\sum_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(X_i) = \sum_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(I_i \times B_i) = \sum_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(I_i) ~~ \mathrm{E}(B_i) ~~~~ \text{from independence of } I_i \text{'s and } B_i \text{'s} \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n \Pr(I_i=1) ~ \mu_i ~~~~ \text{since } E(I_i) \text{ is the probability } I_i \text{ is 1} \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n ~ q_i ~ \mu_i . \end{aligned} $$ For the variance of the aggregate loss under the individual risk model, $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(S_n) &= \sum_{i=1}^n \mathrm{Var}(X_i) ~~~~ \text{from independence of } X_i \text{'s} \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n ~ \left( ~ \mathrm{E}\left[ \mathrm{Var}(X_i | I_i) \right] + \mathrm{Var}\left[ \mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) \right] ~ \right) ~~~~ \text{from conditional variance formulas}  \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n \left( q_i ~ \sigma_i^2 ~ + ~ q_i ~ (1-q_i) ~ \mu_i^2 \right) . \end{aligned} $$ To see this, note that $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}\left[ \mathrm{Var}(X_i | I_i) \right] &= \mathrm{Var}(X_i|I_i=0) ~ \Pr(I_i=0) + \mathrm{Var}(X_i|I_i=1) ~ \Pr(I_i=1) \\ &= q_i ~ \sigma_i^2 + (1-q_i) ~ (0) = q_i ~ \sigma_i^2, \end{aligned} $$ and $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}\left[ \mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) \right] &= q_i ~ (1-q_i) ~ \mu_i^2~, \end{aligned} $$ using the Bernoulli variance shortcut since $\mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) = 0$ when $I_i=0$ (probability $\Pr(I_i=0) = 1-q_i$) and $\mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) = \mu_i$ when $I_i=1$ (probability $\Pr(I_i=1)= q_i$).
segments.translation: 개별위험모형에서 총손실의 기댓값은 $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}(S_n) &=\sum_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(X_i) = \sum_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(I_i \times B_i) = \sum_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(I_i) ~~ \mathrm{E}(B_i) ~~~~ \text{from independence of } I_i \text{'s and } B_i \text{'s} \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n \Pr(I_i=1) ~ \mu_i ~~~~ \text{since } E(I_i) \text{ is the probability } I_i \text{ is 1} \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n ~ q_i ~ \mu_i . \end{aligned} $$입니다. 개별위험모형에서 총손실의 분산은 $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(S_n) &= \sum_{i=1}^n \mathrm{Var}(X_i) ~~~~ \text{from independence of } X_i \text{'s} \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n ~ \left( ~ \mathrm{E}\left[ \mathrm{Var}(X_i | I_i) \right] + \mathrm{Var}\left[ \mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) \right] ~ \right) ~~~~ \text{from conditional variance formulas}  \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n \left( q_i ~ \sigma_i^2 ~ + ~ q_i ~ (1-q_i) ~ \mu_i^2 \right) . \end{aligned} $$입니다. 이를 확인하려면 $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{E}\left[ \mathrm{Var}(X_i | I_i) \right] &= \mathrm{Var}(X_i|I_i=0) ~ \Pr(I_i=0) + \mathrm{Var}(X_i|I_i=1) ~ \Pr(I_i=1) \\ &= q_i ~ \sigma_i^2 + (1-q_i) ~ (0) = q_i ~ \sigma_i^2, \end{aligned} $$이고, $I_i=0$일 때(확률 $\Pr(I_i=0) = 1-q_i$) $\mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) = 0$이고 $I_i=1$일 때(확률 $\Pr(I_i=1)= q_i$) $\mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) = \mu_i$이므로 베르누이 분산의 간편 공식을 사용하면 $$ \begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}\left[ \mathrm{E}(X_i|I_i) \right] &= q_i ~ (1-q_i) ~ \mu_i^2~, \end{aligned} $$임에 주목하십시오.

segments.source: For the probability generating function of the aggregate loss under the individual risk model, $$ \begin{aligned} P_{S_n}(z) &= \prod_{i=1}^n ~ P_{X_i}(z) ~~~~ \text{from the independence of } X_i \text{'s} \\ &= \prod_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(z^{~X_i}) = \prod_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(z^{~I_i \times B_i}) = \prod_{i=1}^n ~\mathrm{E} \left[ \mathrm{E}(z^{~I_i \times B_i} | I_i) \right] ~~~~ \text{from law of iterated expectations} \\ &= \prod_{i=1}^n \left[ ~ E\left(z^{~I_i \times B_i} | I_i=0\right) ~ \Pr(I_i=0) + E\left(z^{~I_i \times B_i} | I_i=1\right) ~ \Pr(I_i=1) ~ \right] \\ &= \prod_{i=1}^n ~ \left[ ~ (1) ~ (1-q_i) + P_{B_i}(z) ~ q_i ~ \right] = \prod_{i=1}^n \left(~ 1-q_i + q_i ~ P_{B_i}(z) ~\right) \end{aligned} $$ Lastly, for the moment generating function of the aggregate loss under the individual risk model,
segments.translation: 개별위험모형에서 총손실의 확률생성함수는 $$ \begin{aligned} P_{S_n}(z) &= \prod_{i=1}^n ~ P_{X_i}(z) ~~~~ \text{from the independence of } X_i \text{'s} \\ &= \prod_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(z^{~X_i}) = \prod_{i=1}^n ~ \mathrm{E}(z^{~I_i \times B_i}) = \prod_{i=1}^n ~\mathrm{E} \left[ \mathrm{E}(z^{~I_i \times B_i} | I_i) \right] ~~~~ \text{from law of iterated expectations} \\ &= \prod_{i=1}^n \left[ ~ E\left(z^{~I_i \times B_i} | I_i=0\right) ~ \Pr(I_i=0) + E\left(z^{~I_i \times B_i} | I_i=1\right) ~ \Pr(I_i=1) ~ \right] \\ &= \prod_{i=1}^n ~ \left[ ~ (1) ~ (1-q_i) + P_{B_i}(z) ~ q_i ~ \right] = \prod_{i=1}^n \left(~ 1-q_i + q_i ~ P_{B_i}(z) ~\right) \end{aligned} $$입니다. 마지막으로, 개별위험모형에서 총손실의 적률생성함수는 다음과 같습니다.

segments.source: Relationship Between Probability Generating Functions of $X_i$ and $X_i^T$
segments.translation: $X_i$와 $X_i^T$의 확률생성함수 사이의 관계

segments.source: Let $X_i$ belong to the $(a,b,0)$ class with *pmf* $p_{ik} = \Pr(X_i = k)$ for $k=0,1,\ldots$ and $X_i^T$ be the associated zero-truncated distribution in the $(a,b,1)$ class with *pmf* $p_{ik}^T = p_{ik}/(1-p_{i0})$ for $k=1,2,\ldots$.
segments.translation: $X_i$가 $k=0,1,\ldots$에 대해 *pmf* $p_{ik} = \Pr(X_i = k)$를 갖는 $(a,b,0)$ 부류에 속하고, $X_i^T$가 $k=1,2,\ldots$에 대해 *pmf* $p_{ik}^T = p_{ik}/(1-p_{i0})$를 갖는 $(a,b,1)$ 부류의 대응하는 영절단 분포라고 합시다.

segments.source: Moment Generating Function of Aggregate Loss $S_N$ in Example 7.3.9
segments.translation: 예제 7.3.9에서 총손실 $S_N$의 적률생성함수

segments.source: For $N\sim Geo(\beta)$ and $X\sim Exp(\theta)$, we have $$ \begin{aligned} P_N (z) &=\frac{1}{1- \beta (z-1)}\\ M_{X}(t) &=\frac{1}{1-\theta t} . \end{aligned} $$ Thus, the *mgf* of aggregate loss $S_N$ is $$ \begin{aligned} M_{S_N}(t) &= P_N [M_{X}(t)] = \frac{1}{1 - \beta \left( \frac{1}{1-\theta t} - 1\right)} \\ &= \frac{1}{1 - \beta \left( \frac{\theta t}{1-\theta t} \right)} + 1 - 1 = 1+ \frac{\beta \left( \frac{\theta t}{1-\theta t} \right)}{1 - \beta \left( \frac{\theta t}{1-\theta t} \right)} \\ &= 1 + \frac{\beta \theta t}{(1-\theta t) - \beta \theta t} = 1+ \frac{\beta \theta t}{1-\theta t (1+\beta)} \cdot \frac{1+\beta}{1+\beta} \\ &= 1 + \frac{\beta}{1+\beta} \left[ \frac{\theta (1+\beta) t}{1-\theta(1+\beta)t} \right] \\ &= 1 + \frac{\beta}{1+\beta} \left[ \frac{1}{1-\theta(1+\beta)t} - 1 \right], \\ \end{aligned} $$ which gives the expression \@ref(eq:case1).
segments.translation: $N\sim Geo(\beta)$ 및 $X\sim Exp(\theta)$에 대해 $$ \begin{aligned} P_N (z) &=\frac{1}{1- \beta (z-1)}\\ M_{X}(t) &=\frac{1}{1-\theta t} . \end{aligned} $$를 얻습니다. 따라서 총손실 $S_N$의 *mgf*는 $$ \begin{aligned} M_{S_N}(t) &= P_N [M_{X}(t)] = \frac{1}{1 - \beta \left( \frac{1}{1-\theta t} - 1\right)} \\ &= \frac{1}{1 - \beta \left( \frac{\theta t}{1-\theta t} \right)} + 1 - 1 = 1+ \frac{\beta \left( \frac{\theta t}{1-\theta t} \right)}{1 - \beta \left( \frac{\theta t}{1-\theta t} \right)} \\ &= 1 + \frac{\beta \theta t}{(1-\theta t) - \beta \theta t} = 1+ \frac{\beta \theta t}{1-\theta t (1+\beta)} \cdot \frac{1+\beta}{1+\beta} \\ &= 1 + \frac{\beta}{1+\beta} \left[ \frac{\theta (1+\beta) t}{1-\theta(1+\beta)t} \right] \\ &= 1 + \frac{\beta}{1+\beta} \left[ \frac{1}{1-\theta(1+\beta)t} - 1 \right], \\ \end{aligned} $$이며, 이로부터 \@ref(eq:case1) 식을 얻습니다.
